# Sada iVoice AI Studio

> High-fidelity 24kHz neural text-to-speech (TTS) and conversational voice synthesis engine engineered with Google Gemini Flash TTS technology. Developed by Eng.Motaz Jamil.

Sada iVoice provides real-time, low-latency audio generation with expressive human emotional inflection and dynamic multi-speaker dialogue synthesis in Arabic and English.

## Canonical URLs
- Web Application: https://sada-ivoice.ai.studio/
- XML Sitemap: https://sada-ivoice.ai.studio/sitemap.xml
- Agent Discovery Catalog: https://sada-ivoice.ai.studio/ai-catalog.json
- LLM Context: https://sada-ivoice.ai.studio/llms.txt

## Key Capabilities
- Single-speaker neural voice generation with 6 studio personas (Puck, Charon, Kore, Fenrir, Aoede, Zephyr).
- Alternating two-speaker dialogue synthesis with turn-by-turn speaker tagging (e.g., "Speaker 1: ...", "Speaker 2: ...").
- High-definition 24,000 Hz, 16-bit PCM uncompressed WAV audio output with RIFF headers.
- Intelligent script prompts across four curated tones: Inspiring, Authoritative, Documentary, and Storytelling.
- Client-side audio waveform visualization, looping, pitch/speed modulation, and one-click WAV download.

## API Endpoints (Agent Accessible)

### 1. Synthesize Single Voice
- Endpoint: `POST /api/synthesize`
- Content-Type: `application/json`
- Parameters:
  - `text` (string, required): Plain text or SSML-like script to convert to speech.
  - `voice` (string, optional): Selected voice persona (Puck, Charon, Kore, Fenrir, Aoede, Zephyr). Default: Puck.
  - `language` (string, optional): Target language code ("ar" or "en").
- Response:
  - Content-Type: `audio/wav`
  - Body: 24kHz uncompressed WAV audio binary stream.

### 2. Synthesize Multi-Speaker Dialogue
- Endpoint: `POST /api/synthesize-dialogue`
- Content-Type: `application/json`
- Parameters:
  - `script` (string, required): Interleaved dialogue formatted with speaker turns.
  - `speaker1Voice` (string): Persona for speaker 1.
  - `speaker2Voice` (string): Persona for speaker 2.
- Response:
  - Content-Type: `audio/wav`
  - Body: Unified multi-speaker 24kHz WAV audio binary stream.

### 3. Generate Creative Voiceover Script
- Endpoint: `POST /api/generate-script`
- Content-Type: `application/json`
- Parameters:
  - `topic` (string): Concept or outline.
  - `tone` (string): inspiring | expert | practical | story.
  - `isDialogue` (boolean): Whether to generate single or dual-speaker script.
- Response:
  - Content-Type: `application/json`
  - Body: `{"title": string, "script": string}`

### 4. Health & Status
- Endpoint: `GET /api/health`
- Response: `{"status": "ok", "timestamp": "ISO-8601"}`

## Voice Personas & Acoustic Profiles
- Puck: Deep, warm, resonant, authoritative storytelling.
- Charon: Gravelly, cinematic, narrative depth.
- Kore: Clear, bright, friendly, conversational.
- Fenrir: Intense, dramatic, powerful, assertive.
- Aoede: Melodic, expressive, soothing, informative.
- Zephyr: Smooth, crisp, energetic, modern advertising tone.
